news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 2026 total revenue rose 11% year-over-year to $8.1 million (beating the ~$7.85M consensus), with record quarterly gross margin of 15% (up 11 points YoY) and recurring revenue up 14% to 63% of total revenue; EPS of -$0.27 missed estimates by $0.02. The company placed its 200th Growth Direct system globally, added four new placements and nine validations in the quarter, and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $37-41M revenue, 30-38 system placements, and ~20% gross margin.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 90,000 RSUs and a non-qualified option to purchase 170,000 shares (exercise price $2.12) as a material inducement to a new employee, issued under its Inducement Plan per Nasdaq Rule 5635(c)(4).

news.headline: Director Richard S. Kollender exercises stock options for 3,508 shares
news.summary: RPID director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 Class A shares at a $0.75 exercise price, a routine insider transaction.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: The company confirmed it would release Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, with a management webcast/conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercises stock option
news.summary: CEO Robert Spignesi exercised a fully vested option for 1,402 Class A shares at $0.75 per share, a routine transaction ahead of the option's August 11, 2026 expiration.

news.headline: RPID affiliate files Form 144 to sell 10,000 Class A shares
news.summary: An insider affiliate (COO John J. Addington Wilson) filed notice to sell 10,000 Class A shares via stock option exercise, continuing a pattern of periodic small insider sales.

catalysts.label: 10 millionth Growth Direct consumable shipment
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 2026 call that the company expects to ship its 10 millionth consumable unit during the third quarter of 2026, a cumulative platform-adoption milestone.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report expected roughly three months after Q2 2026 results, per the company's standard reporting cadence; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Gross margin step-up to mid-20% range
catalysts.detail: Company guided second-half 2026 gross margin to the mid-20% range (versus 15% in Q2) as part of its reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of ~20% full-year gross margin.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 guidance: $37-41M revenue, 30-38 system placements
catalysts.detail: Reaffirmed at Q2 2026 earnings: total revenue guidance of $37.0-$41.0 million and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements for the year.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma distribution partnership ramp
catalysts.detail: MilliporeSigma contributed to system placements in H1 2026, and management expects its contribution to increase meaningfully in H2 2026 and continue into 2027 under the ongoing distribution agreement.

pulse: Q2 2026 results (Aug 7) showed continued steady progress: revenue up 11% YoY to $8.1M (beating consensus), record 15% gross margin, and the 200th Growth Direct system placed globally, with full-year guidance of $37-41M revenue and ~20% gross margin reaffirmed. Aside from earnings, news flow was otherwise quiet, limited to a routine employee inducement equity grant and small, recurring insider option exercises/sales by the CEO, a director, and the COO. The stock remains well off its highs, with the market's focus now shifting to whether the guided H2 acceleration in margins (to the mid-20% range) and system placements materializes toward the $37-41M full-year target.
